description: Defines the FileDescriptorImpl class, a wrapper for file descriptor management including resource handling, move semantics, and automatic closing.

classes.name: FileDescriptorImpl
classes.description: A class that manages a file descriptor, ensuring proper resource management and preventing multiple copies.

methods.name: FileDescriptorImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a file descriptor, logs error if invalid.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Deleted copy assignment operator to prevent copying.

methods.name: operator=(FileDescriptorImpl &&)
methods.description: Move assignment operator that transfers ownership of the file descriptor.

methods.name: ~FileDescriptorImpl
methods.description: Destructor that closes the file descriptor if open.
